views.listenerLimitation: Saved-file inspection cannot see arbitrary code-owned Node listeners; V2 engine fixture lifecycle and real Preview hit testing are separate evidence.

supersededVisualContracts.reason: V21 deliberately retires the old per-cell Sprite while preserving its logic/component/transform; the separately bound V21CleanDustView now renders path-local particles. This is not a claim that the old enabled-renderer assertion passed.
Only the explicitly authorized package version increment changes. The raw historical version assertion and its failure remain visible in legacyAuditSummary.

limitations: No pixel quality, screenshot alignment, native hit testing, physical touch or browser audio is certified by this saved-file audit.
Actual component listeners and runtime timing require a newly executed V2 engine probe; human visual quality requires real Preview screenshots.
This function performs no writes. Original-size screenshots and user art approval are not inferred from resource or source checks.
